scenes.title: Launching the Video Regulation Commission
scenes.summary: While Megumi reads up on studying abroad and asks to stay at her friend's house, rival mogul Ikezawa inaugurates the Japan Video Regulation Commission to mandate mosaic censorship and freeze out newcomers.

scenes.title: Ruling Both Above Ground and Underground
scenes.summary: When Toshi asks yakuza boss Furuya for backup against Ikezawa, Furuya explains that while capital rules the legitimate world, true victory belongs to whoever commands both above ground and underground.

scenes.title: Refusing Recall and Blocked From Distribution
scenes.summary: Ordered by the new regulation commission to recall their tapes and thicken the mosaics, Muranishi flatly refuses to join—leaving the studio shut out of distribution with dwindling funds.

scenes.title: I Will Live as I Please, Just Like You
scenes.summary: Returning home after staying out overnight, Megumi confronts her mother Kayo with the hidden photo of her married father, resolves to live freely as she pleases, and seeks out Toru Muranishi's office.

scenes.title: Opening title sequence
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 5 of The Naked Director.

scenes.title: A Savior Walks Into the Office
scenes.summary: Trapped without actresses or distribution, the crew assumes sheltered college student Megumi wants a crew job—until she announces she wants to perform in an adult video and shares lunch with them.

scenes.title: Wanting to Live as My True Self
scenes.summary: In her preliminary interview with Muranishi, Megumi Sahara confesses she wants tuition to study abroad and longs to embrace her uninhibited true self, asking him first to hold her close.

scenes.title: From Today On, Your Name Is Kaoru Kuroki
scenes.summary: Inspired by her favorite color black, Muranishi christens her Kaoru Kuroki, praises her unshaved natural confidence when Toshi suggests shaving, and halts the camera to prepare a proper studio debut.

scenes.title: If the Eyes Are Blocked, Aim for the Ears
scenes.summary: Determined to outsmart the commission's mosaic rules through sheer imagination, Muranishi decides to appeal to viewers' ears rather than their eyes and sends Toshi out to buy a whistle.

scenes.title: Hands, Open Eyes, and Hunting for a Whistle
scenes.summary: On the studio set, Muranishi advises Kuroki that without a script her living hands and unblinking eyes will tell the whole story, while Toshi scrambles through neighborhood shops for a whistle.

scenes.title: Stepping On Camera With the Conch Whistle
scenes.summary: Stepping in as on-screen partner himself with his encyclopedia-salesman patter, Muranishi hands Kuroki the conch-shell whistle so viewers can gauge her feelings by how many times she blows it.

scenes.title: An Unprecedented Debut Performance
scenes.summary: Casting off restraint, Kuroki takes fierce command of the unscripted shoot, leaving the entire crew awestruck and moved as Kawada vows to release every single frame unedited.

scenes.title: Earning Tuition With My Own Hands
scenes.summary: While Kawada hails the whistle-driven tape as a masterpiece that clears every mosaic rule, Kuroki brings home her first paycheck—driving a horrified Kayo to demand the commission halt its release.
scenes.location: editing room, Sahara home, and commission office

scenes.title: Clear the Commission and I Will Stock Every Copy
scenes.summary: Sharing a smoke and beer with the thriving rental shop manager, Toshi secures a promise to stock as many copies as they want once the new tape clears the regulation commission.

scenes.title: Now It Is Your Turn to Set Her Free
scenes.summary: Summoned before Kayo and the commission, Muranishi voluntarily cancels the release of Kuroki's debut and asks Kayo to set her daughter free—even as nationwide tape returns cut revenue to zero.

scenes.title: You Opened the Door for Me
scenes.summary: Meeting over coffee, Kuroki apologizes for her mother's actions, thanks Muranishi for opening the door that allowed her to affirm her true self, and urges him to keep making great films.

scenes.title: Pitching an Aerial Action Shoot Overseas
scenes.summary: Inspired by a tropical billboard outside the window, Muranishi pitches an audacious overseas aerial shoot; Toshi convinces Kawada to back their general one last time, and the whole crew rallies.
